about.title: A little about me
about.text: I am a backend-focused developer with strong expertise in Python and Django, where I specialize in building and maintaining secure, robust, and scalable databases. I also work with FastAPI to create fast, modern APIs. To complement my backend skills, I use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap to build attractive, fully responsive frontends that adapt seamlessly across devices. I manage version control with Git and GitHub, and I enhance my workflow with AI tools such as Copilot and Claude.

services.title: I do amazing things for clients

photographer.title: Backend
photographer.text: I am an aspiring backend developer with a solid foundation in Python and hands-on experience building RESTful APIs using Django and FastAPI. I have worked with PostgreSQL for database design, including schema definition, query optimization, and basic relationship management.

webdesigner.title: Frontend
webdesigner.text: I am a frontend developer with a good command of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). I use Bootstrap to build responsive, mobile-first interfaces efficiently. My focus is on creating clean, user-friendly layouts with attention to detail and basic interactivity. I understand the importance of cross-browser compatibility and accessibility.

artist.title: Softskills
artist.text: I bring strong problem-solving skills, a commitment to writing clean and maintainable code.I am eager to contribute to real-world projects, learn from senior engineers, and grow within a collaborative, feedback-driven environment.I am ready to apply my energy and dedication to delivering quality solutions in a professional setting.

entry1.title: Python
entry1.text: Because it serves as a foundation for any project that requires rapid development, readability, and a mature ecosystem. Ideal for APIs, data processing, automation, or MVPs.

entry2.title: Django
entry2.text: For monolithic projects with complex CRUD, authentication, admin panel, powerful ORM, and security by default.

entry3.title: FastAPI
entry3.text: For pure APIs, high performance, with automatic documentation, data validation, and asynchronous concurrency.

entry4.title: PostgreSQL
entry4.text: For complex relational databases with support for transactions, indexes, and advanced queries.

entry5.title: JavaScript + CSS + HTML5
entry5.text: For creating dynamic and responsive user interfaces with a good design and user experience.

entry6.title: Bootstrap
entry6.text: For developing responsive and consistent web interfaces with a focus on usability.
